jsonLd.description: Gain manual and automation testing skills with hands‑on labs in KPHB, Hyderabad. 6‑month course provides 91% placement and a 4.5 rating.

mainEntity.name: What is the duration of the Software Testing (Manual + Automation) course?

acceptedAnswer.text: The course runs for 6 months. It is offered as an intermediate program.

mainEntity.name: What topics are covered in the curriculum?

acceptedAnswer.text: The curriculum includes SDLC & STLC, manual testing fundamentals, test case design, defect reporting with Jira, Agile testing principles, introduction to automation, Selenium WebDriver with Java/Python, TestNG/Pytest frameworks, API testing with Postman/Rest Assured, and performance testing basics with JMeter.

mainEntity.name: What are the prerequisites for enrolling in the course?

acceptedAnswer.text: Basic computer knowledge and analytical skills are required. Familiarity with web applications is a plus, and no prior coding experience is needed for the manual testing portion.

mainEntity.name: What career paths can graduates of this course pursue?

acceptedAnswer.text: Graduates can work as QA Engineer, Manual Tester, Automation Test Engineer, Software Test Lead, or Performance Tester.

mainEntity.name: What placement support does CynexAI provide for this course?

acceptedAnswer.text: CynexAI offers job/internship placement assistance with a reported 91 % placement rate. The program includes industry‑aligned training to help students secure roles in quality assurance.

pages.summary: Software Testing (Manual + Automation) course is an intermediate 6‑month program in KPHB, Hyderabad that teaches manual testing, Selenium, API testing, Agile QA and performance testing. It includes hands‑on labs, a certification, and job/internship placement support with a 91 % placement rate. Students learn test planning, defect reporting, automation with Java/Python, and gain skills for roles such as QA Engineer, Automation Test Engineer, and Performance Tester.
